summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): rekordbox.
identityNotes: Research seed; the manufacturer's DDJ-1000 Troubleshooting (Mac) article dated 2022-08-06 documents 12 input and 6 output USB audio channels in its Mac driver configuration, with MASTER/PHONES routing in rekordbox Performance mode. This source establishes audio capability; current OS/driver compatibility, hardware revision, firmware, USB IDs, class compliance, MIDI maps, sample rates, bit depth, full numbered channel maps and physical performance remain unverified. No factory tolerances or physical qualification are claimed.

documents.title: DDJ-1000 Troubleshooting (Mac)
documents.notes: Manufacturer support article dated 2022-08-06; checked 2026-11-18. Exact DDJ-1000 Mac driver configuration: section 6 shows 12 input/6 output channels in Audio Devices; section 7 selects DDJ-1000 : MASTER and DDJ-1000 : PHONES in rekordbox Performance mode. These documented settings do not qualify another platform, driver version or physical unit.

specs.label: USB audio input channels (documented Mac driver configuration)
specs.notes: Manufacturer article dated 2022-08-06 specifies 12 inputs in macOS Audio Devices for the DDJ-1000 Mac driver configuration. This is not a qualification of current OS/driver compatibility or a physical unit.

specs.label: USB audio output channels (documented Mac driver configuration)
specs.notes: Manufacturer article dated 2022-08-06 specifies 6 outputs for its Mac driver configuration. In rekordbox Performance mode, Master Output uses DDJ-1000 : MASTER and Headphones Output uses DDJ-1000 : PHONES. The article does not map all six numbered channels or enumerate sample rates/bit depth.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-1000; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-1000 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Four-channel external mixer routing
steps: Connect known-good external sources to each of the four mixer input paths.
Route each source independently through cue and master.
Repeat with DJ software disconnected where the manual permits analog standalone mixing.
